ui.aboutIntro: Michigan Academy of Innovation and Creativity (MAIC) was founded by a multinational team of professors, lecturers, postgraduate degree holders, and experienced professionals in business, project, and organizational management. The entity is officially registered in the State of Michigan, United States.
ui.visionText: We support young people and everyone seeking to refine their skills, gain experience, and expand their professional networks in pursuit of personal development.
ui.formatsText: As a new initiative, we aspire to meet the ambitions of learners and educators by making knowledge easier to share, simplifying learning, and creating a journey rich in enjoyment and benefit.
